title: Add to a count
summary: COBOL: Add to a count. Add 4 instead. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: ADD changes a numeric item by adding a value to it. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Add to a count with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.
